# Aleph Skill v2.4.0

Aleph 2.4.0 upgrades the bundled research engine to D Research 3.4.0, introduces the additive workspace artifact schema `2.1.0` with full dual-read of `2.0.0`, persists the ledger audit stream, and ships a runtime artifact next to the unchanged capability-complete full artifact. Package and validator versions are `2.4.0`; workspace `schema_version` stays `2.0.0` by default with `2.1.0` available opt-in; new workspaces continue to use `formula_version: 2.1.0`, while formula 2.0.0 artifacts remain replayable.

The release is strictly monotonic over v2.3.1: every previously valid command, route, flag, default, adapter, domain pack, schema, ledger width, and input remains accepted, enforced by a frozen capability-baseline suite.

## Highlights

- D Research is pinned to the GitHub-verified annotated `v3.4.0` tag and bundled from the official byte-attested 210-file runtime profile, including its machine-checkable interop contract and runtime package projection.
- Discovery is capability-based: when the component declares its interop contract (header widths, record types, canonicalization/signature identifiers, routes, entrypoints), compatibility is decided from declared capability; contract-less candidates keep the historical major-3 acceptance.
- The import CLI now persists the audit stream: `lead`, `process`, and `blocker` rows land in a `d-research-import-audit` artifact with all 37 policy columns preserved, bound into the deterministic import receipt by hash; leads are never promoted to evidence.
- Workspace schema `2.1.0` adds optional type-discriminated node `details`, namespaced node `extensions`, explicit `actor_basis`, an accepted edge `confidence` alias for canonical `evidence_confidence`, and explicit `context_modifiers: []`; published machine-readable schemas/catalogs describe both versions, schema `2.0.0` artifacts remain readable, and an explicit sibling-only migration upgrades without rewriting the source.
- The node-builder and causal-edge docs now embed the CI-validated canonical minimal node/edge fixtures, so every advertised artifact shape is validator-accepted.
- The host-policy statement is rewritten repository-wide: Aleph imposes no additional content restrictions of its own; mandatory host, system, and developer policy and applicable law always take precedence; within that scope the simulation completes to the maximum permitted extent with explicit epistemic labels.
- Release assets are deterministic-DEFLATE with a byte-identical rebuild check, and a new `aleph-skill-runtime-v2.4.0.zip` carries the allowlisted transitive runtime closure — including the complete locked D Research component and interop contract — self-described by an embedded `runtime-manifest.json`. The runtime artifact supplements the full artifact; it does not replace it.
- New gateway routes `research:package-metadata`, `research:check-doc-examples`, `research:build-artifacts`, and `research:runtime-self-test` expose the upstream 3.4.0 runtime surfaces. The historical `research:package-check` route remains available and automatically selects the source-package checker or official runtime closure self-test from the attested component profile.
- Audit-bearing receipts now verify the reconstructed audit artifact byte-for-byte and check evidence/lead/audit counts. Ledger acceptance is semantically identical to upstream across all five supported widths; legacy receipts without audit fields and valid historical ledgers remain supported.
- The monotonic guard is frozen from the actual v2.3.1 source and now covers all 16 adapters plus 140 argparse option/default contracts, in addition to routes, files, schemas, packs, ledger widths, record types, and formula versions.

## Compatibility

- No workspace schema migration is required; the `2.1.0` upgrade is opt-in via `migrate_workspace.py --upgrade-schema-2-1` and always produces a sibling workspace with an audit trail.
- No mandatory runtime dependency was added; Python remains 3.10+, Node remains 18+, and Playwright/browser installation is never automatic.
- Existing formula 2.0.0 runs retain their legacy replay contract, and validation reports now state the workspace's resolved formula version.
- Component bindings and research-import, finalization, and validation receipts remain version-bound. Preserve the original workspace, operate on a sibling copy, and regenerate affected receipts before claiming verified or calibrated assurance.
- Existing signed 14/19/22/23/37-column D Research ledgers remain supported with unchanged canonicalization and HMAC semantics; import receipts gain additive audit fields without invalidating old receipts.

## Provenance

The D Research identity is bound at three levels: annotated tag object `65b5b788f841f40b1de50269c5dbf3fd2b51e4d9`, commit `9f9ad30346f3921ab544014b2a15a8fe5734e2e9`, and tree `899e955dea529fad79892d5750d77075c26aecc3`. The two archive hashes describe different encodings of that same source identity: `19ebdb0281a6b24aa6cc252f4d8404f052b6f671366818eb913454eab3779795` is the reproducible raw Git archive tar; `7de771335576bebb93b66e3f89aad87a6355b175c11e63d4b508feeddbd5d366` is the release-workflow tar.gz. The vendored runtime projection contains 210 locked files with component-tree SHA-256 `7c382b677cce9b228bb81e053fc6897e4c4dca49288a73577ef205c1aee18cfc`.

## Upgrade from v2.3.1

Install or extract v2.4.0 into a clean skill directory and retain the verified v2.3.1 package plus untouched workspaces as rollback copies. Choose the `full` artifact for development, evaluation, and test-bearing installs; choose the `runtime` artifact for capability-complete execution without the development surfaces.

```powershell
$env:ALEPH_SKILL_ROOT = (Resolve-Path 'C:\absolute\path\to\aleph-skill').Path
python "$env:ALEPH_SKILL_ROOT\scripts\preflight.py" --json
python "$env:ALEPH_SKILL_ROOT\scripts\research_gateway.py" research:preflight --json
python "$env:ALEPH_SKILL_ROOT\scripts\research_gateway.py" research:self-test --json
python "$env:ALEPH_SKILL_ROOT\scripts\validate_skill_package.py" "$env:ALEPH_SKILL_ROOT"
```

Require bundled D Research `package_version: 3.4.0`, `path: aleph-component://d-research`, and a passing component lock. The preflight report now includes the component's interop contract next to the importer's ledger contract; both must agree before research import claims compatibility. Browser checks may remain explicitly delegated on hosts without an installed Playwright browser; lock, ledger, policy, or gateway failures may not be delegated.

To adopt schema 2.1 for an existing workspace:

```powershell
python "$env:ALEPH_SKILL_ROOT\scripts\migrate_workspace.py" --source "$env:ALEPH_RUN" --out "$env:ALEPH_RUN-v2.1" --upgrade-schema-2-1
```

The upgrade byte-preserves every artifact, invalidates version-bound receipts, and records the model/packet re-run bindings in the migration audit trail; re-run validation on the sibling before claiming any assurance tier.

## Rollback to v2.3.1

Restore the verified v2.3.1 package together with untouched pre-upgrade workspaces and their original receipts. Aleph 2.3.1 does not read schema `2.1.0` workspaces, the audit-stream import artifact, or the runtime release profile. Do not hand-edit component bindings, HMACs, package versions, hashes, or receipts to simulate a downgrade.

## Release verification

The release workflow is configured to require package validation, adapter drift checks, exact upstream tag/tree/archive verification, locked-component verification, D Research package and component self-tests, adversarial acceptance, canonical ledger parity across all five supported widths, the full Aleph unit/integration suite, branch coverage, preflight, simulation lifecycle checks, static analysis, and deterministic release-asset reproduction. Treat the release as verified only after the tagged GitHub Actions run completes successfully and the published assets reproduce deterministically.

## Verify assets after publication

After the release is published, download `aleph-skill-v2.4.0.zip`, `aleph-skill-runtime-v2.4.0.zip`, `distribution-manifest.json`, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` into one directory:

```sh
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt
gh attestation verify aleph-skill-v2.4.0.zip \
  --repo d-init-d/aleph-skill \
  --signer-workflow d-init-d/aleph-skill/.github/workflows/release.yml \
  --source-ref refs/tags/v2.4.0
for asset in aleph-skill-runtime-v2.4.0.zip distribution-manifest.json SHA256SUMS.txt; do
  gh attestation verify "$asset" \
    --repo d-init-d/aleph-skill \
    --signer-workflow d-init-d/aleph-skill/.github/workflows/release.yml \
    --source-ref refs/tags/v2.4.0
done
```

The build-provenance records are stored by GitHub's attestation service rather than attached as separate release files. The runtime archive additionally embeds `runtime-manifest.json`, whose per-file SHA-256 entries and ordered tree hash must match the extracted contents.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/d-init-d/aleph-skill/blob/v2.4.0/CHANGELOG.md) and the [comparison with v2.3.1](https://github.com/d-init-d/aleph-skill/compare/v2.3.1...v2.4.0) for the complete change set.
